summary: A self-hosted, one-click PDF rent receipt generator for landlords and tenants. Produces a signed receipt PDF with landlord/tenant names, property, amount, date, payment method, period, and signature line. No account, no subscription.
buyer: Small landlords and tenants who need a signed rent receipt PDF for their records or tax/rental assistance purposes.
why_pay: Free rent receipt templates are static PDFs/Word docs you must fill in by hand and cannot easily print a clean signed copy; accounting software is overkill. This runs locally, generates a real PDF instantly, no account.

demand_evidence.quote: all the people in the trades are extremely overwhelmed with work. There is a lot to be done and not enough people to do it.

delivery.how: Buyer downloads a ZIP from the Stripe payment link after paying, extracts it, runs python3 service.py, opens frontend/index.html, fills the form, and downloads a signed rent receipt PDF.
delivery.test_note: Service tested end-to-end: /health returns ok, POST /rent-receipt returns HTTP 200 with a valid PDF (%PDF-1.4). ZIP at /work/rent-receipt-generator.

downsides: Only 1 verified demand quote found so far (need 2 more per coach rule before submitting). Self-hosted — buyer must run a Python script. Requires owner-approved Stripe link.
